summary: The Bank of Nova Scotia filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing an interest rate reset on its $1.25 billion Fixed Rate Resetting Limited Recourse Capital Notes, Series 1 (NVCC) for the five-year period starting July 27, 2026. The new rate is 5.987% per annum, set as Government of Canada Yield plus 2.761%. The notes mature July 27, 2081, with quarterly interest payments. The filing is a routine contractual rate adjustment on existing subordinated debt, not a special situation. No event triggering a special-situation classification—just an interest rate reset on previously issued capital notes.
